title: V/STOL Training Landing Signal Officer (I) (Col to Capt) NMOS (7509, 8042), DC AVN
raw_text:
52. MOS 7589, V/STOL Training Landing Signal Officer (I) (Col to Capt) NMOS
(7509, 8042), DC AVN

    a. Summary. AV-8B Vertical/Short Takeoff and Landing (V/STOL) Training
Landing Signal Officers (TLSO) control launch and recovery of Fixed Wing
V/STOL Aircraft aboard carriers, amphibious platforms, and field carrier
landing practice (FCLP) in all weather conditions. Additionally, TLSOs
conduct aircrew and air department training and certify basic, advanced, and
training LSOs.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Refer to V/STOL Shipboard & LSO Manual 00-80T-111.

            (2) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligibility.

       c.   Requirements.   Refer to V/STOL Shipboard & LSO Manual 00-80T-111.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Ensures safe and expeditious launch and recovery of V/STOL
Aircraft aboard carriers and amphibious platforms.

        (2) Conducts aircrew training on shipboard launch, approach, and
landing procedures and techniques.



                                           1-303                        Enclosure (1)
 1143                                                                  NAVMC 1200.1L



            (3) Evaluates and certifies AV-8B V/STOL LSOs.

            (4) Conducts air department training on shipboard AV-8B procedures.

        (5) Upon meeting all eligibility listed for the certification of this
MOS, the individual recipient shall coordinate with their unit administration
department to ensure this MOS is added to their Official Military Personnel
File (OMPF) in order to accurately reflect the corresponding aviation
qualification/designation within their permanent record.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
V/STOL Aircraft Launch and Recover Officers (NO CODE).

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators.
